item.title: Version 1.1.21
item.description:
What's New in StockDeck 1.1.21

  • Improved Superchart: Add chart hover details, custom date ranges, favorite timeframes, and synchronized chart controls in the table view.
  • Persistent Chart Settings: Save indicator settings, pane sizes, and toolbar timeframe and timerange choices independently for each chart surface.
  • Portfolio Ordering: Sort Superchart portfolio symbols by holding market value, with duplicate holdings combined and values converted to the preferred currency.
